WEAPONS IN THE ORDER YOU BUY THEM
AIM LOCK: AIM NEAR AN ENEMY (SETTINGS: SNAP MODE)
techniques: {jump} against a wall in the air
{slide} in the air, then {jump} as you land
hold {grapple} at a lit node, {reel} to reel in
hudLegend: your aim; the ticks close in and turn white while the aim lock holds a target
momentum along your aim; past half it takes your style colour (a melee hit becomes an IMPACT)
the target the aim lock holds (LOCK when you locked it with the lock-on key)
a hit; bigger on a headshot, red-orange on a kill
health (the bar turns red-orange when low), stamina, speed, wall jumps left
points, your weapons, what right mouse and SPECIAL do with the one in hand
ui.howToPlay: SURVIVAL: hold the BUY key to buy. Gates open new zones; the ARMORY sells weapons; perks sit in the zones. Style multiplies points. Standing still gets you EXPOSED. Parry boss orbs into the core. Health comes back when you stop taking damage.
